s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive headache with nausea and vomiting, associated with subarachnoid hemorrhage and cerebral edema, in a young adult with a history of recent travel
salient_findings: Progressive headache with nausea and vomiting
Subarachnoid hemorrhage and mild cerebral edema on CT head
Diffuse leptomeningeal thickening on MRI head
key_facts: Recent travel to the United States through Mexico
No elevated temperature or respiratory symptoms
Normal electrolytes, glucose level, blood urea nitrogen level, creatinine level, and liver function test results
Serum complement-fixation IgG antibody titers of 1:512
CSF analysis showed leukocytic pleocytosis without eosinophilia
Elevated CSF protein (409 mg/dL) and low glucose (10 mg/dL)

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive headache with nausea and vomiting, associated with subarachnoid hemorrhage and cerebral edema, in a young adult with a history of recent travel
salient_findings: Progressive headache with nausea and vomiting
Subarachnoid hemorrhage and mild cerebral edema on CT head
Diffuse leptomeningeal thickening on MRI head
key_facts: Recent travel to the United States through Mexico
No elevated temperature or respiratory symptoms
Normal electrolytes, glucose level, blood urea nitrogen level, creatinine level, and liver function test results
Serum complement-fixation IgG antibody titers of 1:512
CSF analysis showed leukocytic pleocytosis without eosinophilia
Elevated CSF protein (409 mg/dL) and low glucose (10 mg/dL)

differentials: Subarachnoid hemorrhage due to ruptured aneurysm
Primary angiitis of the central nervous system
Chronic lymphocytic inflammation with pontine expansion
per_call: Subarachnoid hemorrhage due to ruptured aneurysm
Primary angiitis of the central nervous system
Chronic lymphocytic inflammation with pontine expansion

shortlist.label: Coccidioidomycosis meningitis
shortlist.why_kept: Recent travel to the United States through Mexico, consistent with exposure to Coccidioides immitis, and CSF analysis showing leukocytic pleocytosis and elevated protein

shortlist.label: Histoplasmosis meningitis
shortlist.why_kept: Recent travel history and symptoms consistent with histoplasmosis, a fungal infection that can cause meningitis

shortlist.label: Tuberculous meningitis
shortlist.why_kept: Mild anemia, hypotonic hyponatremia, and CSF analysis showing leukocytic pleocytosis and elevated protein, consistent with tuberculous meningitis

shortlist.label: Cysticercosis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's Guatemalan origin and recent travel history increase the risk of cysticercosis, a parasitic infection that can cause neurological symptoms

shortlist.label: Neurocysticercosis
shortlist.why_kept: Similar to cysticercosis, neurocysticercosis is a parasitic infection that can cause neurological symptoms, and the patient's travel history and symptoms are consistent with this diagnosis
